plain.li: Another year on the rim, and most of us are still here.
No one can say what next year will bring. We'll plant in spring, as usual, and see.
[annals:losses] We lost people this year. Their names should be carved somewhere that will last longer than this page.
[annals:violent] We spent most of this year with weapons close at hand. I'd like to spend the next one with a hoe.
[annals:peaceful] A quiet year. I don't trust it, but I'll take it.
[annals:richer] We have more than we did a year ago, and raiders will have heard. Keep the walls in good repair.
[annals:growing] More mouths to feed and more hands to work. There's a queue for the stew pot now.
[winter] It's snowing as I write this. We've made it through another year.

warm.li: Whatever happens next year, I'm glad it's with all of you.
[annals:losses] I keep their places at the table in my head. I think I always will.
[annals:growing] There are a lot of new faces at supper now. I hope they're starting to feel at home.

blunt.li: That's the year. Most of it was mud and hard work.
[annals:violent] They keep coming. We keep burying them. Fine by me.
[annals:peaceful] Nothing tried to kill us this year. Don't get used to it.

cheerful.li: What a year! Terrible in places and wonderful in others. Same again next year, please, without the terrible parts.
[annals:richer] We're richer than we've ever been! Someone should buy a nice hat.
[annals:peaceful] Not a single raid all year! I'd like that written in large letters.

gloomy.li: Another year closer to the end. We got through this one, anyway.
[annals:losses] The graveyard is bigger than it was last year.
[annals:violent] I've stopped counting the raids in my head. I only count who's left.

cold.li: That concludes the year. Survival rate acceptable.
[annals:losses] Losses were within expectations. Replace them.
[annals:richer] Our wealth grew this year. The raids will grow with it.
